title: Business Summary
description: Reusable location-independent identity metadata for a business, brand, or seller.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the business, brand, or seller (e.g., `'Joe\'s Pizza'`).

media.description: Business-level media items, such as a brand `logo` (`role: 'logo'`) or `cover` image (`role: 'cover'`).

links.description: Business-level links, such as the canonical customer-facing `website` storefront URL and business-wide policy links (`privacy_policy`, `terms_of_service`, `refund_policy`, `shipping_policy`, `faq`).

address.description: Corporate, headquarters, or registered legal address of the business. Physical retail branches live in `dev.ucp.common.location.*`.
